derived_results.statement: For w=(-1,3,-3,1), sums against j^r vanish for r=0,1,2 and equal 6 at r=3; perturb first-order channel intensities in X->jY while keeping second-order 2X->X+jY fixed. Finite-volume drift and covariance agree pointwise, third Y jump-moment differs.
Every channel decrements X by one and aggregate hazard q(x) is unchanged; complete timestamped X-only paths have TV=0 and zero Fisher information along the circuit contrast.

For event-resolved marks, path KL is E_1 sum_events KL(Cat(p1(.|X-))||Cat(p0(.|X-))); any parameter-independent noisy/partial Markov sensor contracts KL/TV and Fisher information. Unrestricted alpha nuisance makes the network label a redundant parameter.

At X0=Omega=5, full ordered-mark path TV=6639421/44800000=0.14820136 and KL=0.06724206; terminal total-Y TV=16791/3200000=0.00524719 and KL=0.000232125. Pinsker necessary independent batches for TV>=0.8: 20 versus 5515.

costs_and_limits.finite_fixture: Five events per batch, at most 40 propensity evaluations per naive SSA batch; complete batch mean duration 1175/252=4.6627 s under synthetic rates; enumeration has 4^5=1024 paths. No rare-event accelerator or physical chemistry run needed.
costs_and_limits.large_state: Dynamic programming over reachable (x,y) states is O(X0^2) state count; brute path enumeration grows exponentially. No partial-observation particle filter was implemented.
costs_and_limits.prior_boundary: Exact rate-map inference presumes finite known transition-vector set, order bound, and exact map data covering |S_N|=binom(N+d,d) states. It is not direct acquisition from noisy partial discrete observations.
costs_and_limits.caveats: Pinsker counts are necessary not sufficient for known simple hypotheses. Unknown unconstrained rates create exact overlap; no chemical rates, transition-state barriers, or calibrated sensors supplied.

falsifier: Independent exact rational reproduction must recover the moment circuit, equal finite-volume first/second moments, X-only TV=0, and stated event-path/endpoint TV and KL. A physical X-only discrepancy under stipulated propensities falsifies at least one modeling/observation assumption.
novelty: No network inference method novelty claimed after EEK audit. The exact sensor-specific witness may be historically new in this form, but priority was not established. Moment circuit, exact rate-map reconstruction, and data-processing arguments are established mathematical ingredients.
